name: map-block-gutenberg

gmw-map-block-key.note: Provision with env-set on each target. Native maps bind this target-local key; source default and explicit historical keys are never transported. The target key cannot be the PHP-falsey string 0, which the native editor replaces with its bundled fallback.

notes: The 1.35 native static saver is a closed leaf: zoom 1..21, height 50..1000, UTF-8 address up to 8192 bytes, API key 1..64 ASCII letters/digits/underscore/hyphen. Missing native defaults normalize. Unknown attributes, custom HTML, mismatched attribute/iframe keys and malformed values refuse without values in diagnostics.

Canonical api_key and iframe key contain only @env. All maps intentionally bind the provisioned target option, including maps saved with an explicit or historical source key. Apply locks and verifies target-local env-set intent before writes. The bundled public fallback key is never used on a target.
